entries.dialogueText: "Rizia's economy is a balanced mix of energy resources, manufacturing, and agricultural sectors, providing steady growth, diversified income streams, and a strong foundation for future development."

entries.title: Narrator: ""Overall, the energy crisis persist..."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""However, given their minimal influ..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, given their minimal influence on policy, we don’t expect much interference; their role will be little more than ceremonial."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Given that they’ll hold equal powe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Given that they’ll hold equal power over laws, we can expect delays and complications as these 'blue bloods' bicker over every little detail."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Your Majesty, the House of Lords w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, the House of Lords will begin its duties after the elections, though I doubt it will be anything but a drawn-out affair as they settle into their self-important roles."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Which is exactly what they deserve.""
entries.dialogueText: "Which is exactly what they deserve."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: "“Voter registration is progressing..."
entries.dialogueText: “Voter registration is progressing well, Your Majesty."

entries.dialogueText: "Participation is high in the cities, though some of the more remote regions have been slower to respond.”

entries.dialogueText: “Voter registration is moving forward, Your Majesty.”
